claims.object_text: malignant progression and favorable overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS)
claims.quote: KCNB1 as a novel ion gene, associated with malignant progression and favorable overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) in glioma patients from three datasets (CGGA, GSE16011 and REMBRANDT).

claims.object_text: autophagy induction accompanied by increased apoptosis and reduced proliferation and invasion of glioma cells
claims.quote: we characterized a novel function of autophagy induction accompanied by increased apoptosis and reduced proliferation and invasion of glioma cells for KCNB1.

claims.object_text: ERK pathway is involved in KCNB1-mediated regulation of autophagy
claims.quote: the ERK pathway is involved in KCNB1-mediated regulation of autophagy

claims.object_text: inhibition of KCNB1-induced autophagy by a selective ERK1/2 inhibitor (U0126) or siERK1/2
claims.quote: which was confirmed by inhibition of KCNB1-induced autophagy by using a selective ERK1/2 inhibitor (U0126) or siERK1/2.
In vivo studies showed that KCNB1 induced autophagy while inhibiting tumor growth and increasing survival.
